units.known_address_notes: OZ audit of the ERC-7579/7913 account framework built for Zama's fhEVM; scope commit 6e14ef83. The repo publishes deployments.json with a Sepolia block (chain 11155111) containing the factory, account implementation and the validators named in the report; three were code-checked and are source-verified. No mainnet deployment exists in the manifest, so the exact audited instance is the Sepolia deployment.
